mission_04: Many real-world datasets exhibit right-skewed distributions where most values cluster near zero but a few extreme values stretch the tail. Salary, house prices, and transaction amounts are classic examples. Log transformation compresses large values and expands small ones, making the distribution more symmetric and closer to normal. This is important because many statistical methods and machine learning algorithms assume approximately normal distributions. In this mission, you will use np.log1p() (which computes log(1+x) safely handling zeros) to reduce skewness and compare the results.
